HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
REVIEW OFFICER / ASSISTANT REVIEW OFFICER /COMPUTER
ASSISTANT RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION-2026
Public Notice
27th November, 2026
Adv No.: 02/REVIEW OFFICER/ASSISTANT REVIEW OFFICER/COMPUTER ASSISTANT/2026 Dated: 01.06.2026
In reference to the Review Officer/Assistant Review Officer/Computer Assistant
Recruitment Examination-2026 issued vide Adv No.: 02/REVIEW OFFICER/ASSISTANT
REVIEW OFFICER/COMPUTER ASSISTANT/2026, Dated: 01.06.2026, it is hereby
informed to all the concerned that the Review Officer/Assistant Review Officer/Computer
Assistant Recruitment Examination-2026 will be conducted by Tata Consultancy Services Ltd.
The Stage-I (Preliminary Examination-General Studies) which was earlier scheduled to be
conducted in OMR based Mode (as per advertisement) now be conducted in Computer Based Test (CBT)
Mode in various shifts and different dates. Rest terms, conditions and modalities as enshrined in the
advertisement uploaded vide notice dated 01.06.2026 will remain intact.
The Stage-I Examination for the Review Officer/Assistant Review Officer/Computer
Assistant Recruitment Examination-2026 is scheduled on 08th, 09th and 10th December in
various shifts in the following cities at the various centers of State of Uttar Pradesh:
Agra
Lucknow
Aligarh
Moradabad
Bareilly
Muzaffarnagar
Ghaziabad
Meerut
Gorakhpur
Noida
Jhansi
Prayagraj
Kanpur
Varanasi

website. Candidates are required to Click on the below mentioned link for downloading their
